substeps.caption: An example run in the lab as set up: two Kardex Shuttles with every tray loaded (A-O), the floor machines, one MiR250 + UR10e docked at Shuttle 1's opening and the other on its charger. The multi-doser doses 25 mg of an atomized powder and the CubXL adds electrolyte to it, DAL's powder reactivity test (PR #180, cubxl-setup.md §8: 10-50 mg of each atomizer run's powder; the metal it gives up tracks its oxide).

The arm parks. Our pusher slides the HR-202i's -y side door back, the shuttle carries the vial in, 6 mm over our pedestal on the pan, and drops: the vial stands on the pedestal, its rim 156 mm under the auger's exit, and the fork backs out round it. Nothing else touches the balance.

Module 6 tilts 30°, cap end up; the dose falls 156 mm through the open top door into the vial on the pan. v5's dose-to doses by weight: a quarter auger turn, then a reading over RS-232, until the HR-202i reads 25 mg (readings illustrative): a heap 6 mm across, drawn to scale. Then tilt back, reverse one turn at rest, park.

The CubXL's own P20 (1-20 µL) takes a 20 µL tip, the capper lifts the seawater cap, and 10 transfers of 20 µL put 200 µL on the powder, 0.4 mm deep (to scale). The copper deck's chloride stock is seawater; DAL's §8 names 0.6 M NaCl.
